capturedFrom.asOfNote: fundMetrics/fiMetrics/fiIrr date their terminal NAV with new Date(). Pinned to AS_OF so the IRR figures are reproducible (ADR-021). Arithmetic unchanged.
capturedFrom.localeNote: fte / fteAtEntry / fteNB display strings come from Number.toLocaleString() with no explicit locale. They are locale-sensitive; a CI mismatch here is a locale difference, not a metric change. The TypeScript port must pin a locale.
